required_identity_evidence: absolute Apptainer launcher path digest version and build configuration
content-addressed SIF or reproducible sandbox image identity
GPU driver and injected library identity when NVIDIA passthrough is enabled
required_recovery_evidence: persistent cache scratch and result locators outside the container workspace
timeout signal escalation and terminal process state
retained sandbox overlay or content-addressed recovery artifact on failure
fresh record root for every new execution
required_runtime_evidence: non-root principal plus observed user namespace fakeroot FUSE and cgroup mode readiness
effective contain bind mount writable overlay and network arguments
container exit stdout stderr usage and accelerator observations
artifact export completion and standalone verification before teardown
